messages.author: 9548b9e0c8258268
messages.subject: unmarked 0.8-5 released
parts:
Hi all,

You can now install unmarked version 0.8-5 from CRAN.  Primary changes are:

  • A change in how to specify a nullmodel argument to modSel().  Previously, the argument for null model was a fitted model object.  Now, it takes a character name of the fit within the included fitList.
  • Fixed a bug in printing modSel results where it broke for long formulae.
Best,
Ian

--
Ian Fiske
PhD Candidate
Department of Statistics
North Carolina State University

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: unmarked 0.8-5 released
parts:
Hi Courtney,

Have you tried removing unmarked (and its dependencies, i.e: Rcpp, RcppArmadillo, plyr, and reshape) before installing the zip file? You can find where these packages are located using:

.libPaths()

After you remove the dependencies, re-install them, and then try running a command like:

install.packages("unmarked_0.9-9.tar.gz", repo=NULL)

If that doesn't work, then please show the error messages you get. I don't think there is anything wrong with the zip file.

Richard
